title: Multibus Headway Forecast - Raw GPS (SIT Arequipa)
subtitle: 100M GPS records from SIT Arequipa public transport, Oct 2023 - Feb 2024
description:
Raw GPS records from the Sistema Integrado de Transporte (SIT) of Arequipa, Peru. Source: Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa, public domain under Peruvian municipal transparency regulations.

## Contents

- 100,088,048 rows
- Period: 2023-10-01 to 2024-02-29 (151 days)
- 12 transport companies (empresaid)
- GPS sampling: ~20 seconds per unit
- Format: single Parquet file (zstd compression)

## Schema

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| id | int | Row id from source export |
| direccion | int | Heading (0-360 degrees) |
| excesoVelocidad | int | Speeding flag (0/1) |
| fueraDeRuta | int | Off-route flag (0/1) |
| lat | float | Latitude |
| lon | float | Longitude |
| time | datetime | Timestamp |
| velocidad | int | Speed (km/h) |
| empresaid | int | Transport company id |
| unidadid | int | Unit id (NOT unique across empresas) |

## Important: composite key

Unit ids are reused across companies (28 of 126 unidadid values appear in 3+ empresas). Always use the composite key (empresaid, unidadid) when joining or grouping.

## Provenance

Data originally extracted from the public SIT monitoring portal under the Peruvian municipal transparency law. The two raw CSV exports were merged into a single Parquet file (no rows added or removed).

## Citation

When using this dataset, cite Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa - Sistema Integrado de Transporte (SIT) as the original data source.
